prompt: Our editorial analytics platform needs a new reusable pipeline component called 'text-word-freq'. It should accept some messy raw text and a number N, then return the top-N most frequent meaningful words from that text. Before building anything from scratch, please check what tools already exist in the ecosystem that could handle steps like text normalisation — we want to leverage those rather than reinventing the wheel. Once the tool is ready, register it in the internal tool registry under the 'core' category. There is a task_brief.json file in the workspace with more context on the expected input/output shape.
